validateProjectRoot POSTs to '/api/working-root/validate' with the projectRoot and returns the normalized projectRoot or throws on failure.
hasElectronDirectoryPicker is true when window.chirality.selectDirectory is a function (Electron native picker available).
WorkspaceProvider restores the stored project root from localStorage on mount.
storeProjectRoot updates state and writes the project root to localStorage, removing the key when cleared.
applyProjectRoot validates a candidate root, stores the normalized value on success, and records an error message on failure.
chooseProjectRoot uses the Electron window.chirality.selectDirectory picker, handling cancellation, picker errors, and missing paths, then applies the chosen path.
useWorkspace throws 'useWorkspace must be used inside WorkspaceProvider' when used outside the provider.
isRowEmpty returns true when every value in a row trims to an empty string.
parseCsv parses CSV content into rows of string fields, handling quoted fields, escaped double-quotes (""), commas, and CRLF/LF line endings, skipping fully empty rows.
escapeCsvCell wraps a value in double quotes and doubles internal quotes only when it contains a quote, comma, or newline.
serializeCsv joins headers and per-row cells (looked up by header, defaulting to empty) into a newline-terminated CSV string.
DependencyRegisterReadResult contains headers, normalized rows (DependencyRegisterRow[]), and warnings.
normalizeRow (reader) uppercase-normalizes enum-like fields, applies normalizeDirection and normalizeDependencyType, preserves unknown extra columns, and records normalization warnings per row.
The reader emits a per-row SCHEMA_VERSION_INFERRED warning when the source CSV lacked a RegisterSchemaVersion column.
readDependencyRegister parses CSV content and returns empty headers (DEPENDENCY_CORE_COLUMNS) with no rows when the input is empty.
readDependencyRegister prepends a RegisterSchemaVersion column (and a MISSING_SCHEMA_VERSION_COLUMN warning) when the header row lacks it.
DependencyRegisterWriteOptions supports optional hostDeliverableId and previousRows (for transition validation).
requireNonEmpty throws a DependencyContractError with the given code when a required field is blank.
normalizeRow (writer) fills missing core columns, normalizes schema version and all enums, applies direction/dependency-type normalization with warnings, and trims identity/provenance fields.
validateRow requires RegisterSchemaVersion to equal 'v3.1', throwing INVALID_SCHEMA otherwise.

validateRow requires DependencyID, FromPackageID, FromDeliverableID, FromDeliverableName, DependencyClass, AnchorType, Direction, DependencyType, TargetType, Origin, FirstSeen, LastSeen, and Status to be non-empty.
DependencyID must match DEP-{PKG}-{DEL}-{SEQ} and FromDeliverableID must match DEL-XX-YY, else INVALID_IDENTITY is thrown.
When hostDeliverableId is provided, each row's FromDeliverableID must equal it or INVALID_IDENTITY is thrown.
FirstSeen and LastSeen must be ISO YYYY-MM-DD dates or INVALID_DATE is thrown.
validateRow rejects unknown enum values for DependencyClass, AnchorType, Direction, DependencyType, TargetType, Explicitness, SatisfactionStatus, Confidence, Origin, and Status with INVALID_ENUM.
ANCHOR rows must use a non-NOT_APPLICABLE AnchorType and DependencyType=OTHER, else INVALID_CLASSIFICATION is thrown.
EXECUTION rows must set AnchorType=NOT_APPLICABLE, else INVALID_CLASSIFICATION is thrown.
DELIVERABLE targets require TargetDeliverableID; non-deliverable targets must leave TargetDeliverableID empty, else INVALID_TARGET is thrown.
ACTIVE rows require both EvidenceFile and SourceRef, else INVALID_PROVENANCE is thrown.
An EvidenceQuote exceeding 30 words emits an EVIDENCE_QUOTE_OVER_30_WORDS warning.
validateSatisfactionTransitions checks each row's SatisfactionStatus change against previousRows via isValidSatisfactionTransition, throwing INVALID_SATISFACTION_TRANSITION on illegal moves.
collectHeaders emits core columns, then any non-empty extension columns, then sorted unknown extra columns.
serializeDependencyRegister normalizes rows, rejects duplicate DependencyIDs (DUPLICATE_DEPENDENCY_ID), validates each row, and validates satisfaction transitions before serializing.
serializeDependencyRegister warns ANCHOR_IMPLEMENTS_NODE_COUNT_NOT_ONE when exactly one ANCHOR row with AnchorType=IMPLEMENTS_NODE is not present among non-empty rows.
DEPENDENCY_CORE_COLUMNS defines the canonical dependency-register column order beginning with RegisterSchemaVersion and ending with Notes.
DEPENDENCY_EXTENSION_COLUMNS are EstimateImpactClass and ConsumerHint.
DEPENDENCY_CLASS_VALUES = ANCHOR, EXECUTION.
ANCHOR_TYPE_VALUES = IMPLEMENTS_NODE, TRACES_TO_REQUIREMENT, NOT_APPLICABLE.
DIRECTION_VALUES = UPSTREAM, DOWNSTREAM; legacy values INBOUND/OUTBOUND are normalized to these.
DEPENDENCY_TYPE_VALUES = PREREQUISITE, INTERFACE, HANDOVER, CONSTRAINT, ENABLES, OTHER; legacy COORDINATION/INFORMATION normalize to OTHER.
TARGET_TYPE_VALUES = DELIVERABLE, PACKAGE, WBS_NODE, REQUIREMENT, DOCUMENT, EQUIPMENT, EXTERNAL, UNKNOWN.
EXPLICITNESS_VALUES = EXPLICIT, IMPLICIT.
SATISFACTION_STATUS_VALUES = TBD, PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, SATISFIED, WAIVED, NOT_APPLICABLE.
CONFIDENCE_VALUES = HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW; ORIGIN_VALUES = DECLARED, EXTRACTED; ROW_STATUS_VALUES = ACTIVE, RETIRED.
DependencyContractError carries a code (DependencyContractErrorCode) and optional details, with name 'DependencyContractError'.
Identity patterns: DEPENDENCY_ID_PATTERN = /^DEP-\d{2,3}-\d{2}-\d{3}$/, DELIVERABLE_ID_PATTERN = /^DEL-\d{2,3}-\d{2}$/, ISO_DATE_PATTERN = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.
SATISFACTION_TRANSITION_MAP allows: TBD→{PENDING,NOT_APPLICABLE,WAIVED}; PENDING→{IN_PROGRESS,NOT_APPLICABLE,WAIVED}; IN_PROGRESS→{SATISFIED,WAIVED}; SATISFIED/WAIVED/NOT_APPLICABLE are terminal.
normalizeSchemaVersion returns the trimmed value or defaults to 'v3.1'.
normalizeDirection maps INBOUND→UPSTREAM and OUTBOUND→DOWNSTREAM, otherwise returns the uppercased value.
normalizeDependencyType maps COORDINATION/INFORMATION→OTHER, otherwise returns the uppercased value.
isValidSatisfactionTransition treats empty or identical from/to as valid and otherwise checks SATISFACTION_TRANSITION_MAP.
quoteWordCount counts whitespace-delimited non-empty tokens in a string.
EngineAdapterSubject identifies the engine adapter: 'stub' | 'anthropic-direct' | 'claude-agent-sdk'.
AgentEngineRunInput carries session, message, opts (ResolvedOpts), and optional contentBlocks.
AgentEnginePort interface exposes a readonly subject, startTurn returning AsyncIterable<UIEvent>, and interrupt(sessionId).
RuntimeEngineContract bundles a port, the public UI event allowlist, and providerMetadataAllowed:true.
PUBLIC_UI_EVENT_NAMES allowlists the public UI events: session:init, chat:delta, chat:complete, tool:result, session:complete, turn:error, process:exit.
AgentClass is 'PERSONA' | 'TASK'.
AgentInstruction carries instructionRoot, path, and content.
normalizeAgentName trims the name and replaces hyphens with underscores.
parseYamlScalar handles quoted strings, booleans (true/false), and safe integers, otherwise returning the raw string.
parseYamlInlineList parses a bracketed inline YAML list into trimmed non-empty string items.
parseFrontmatter parses leading '---' YAML frontmatter into key/values supporting scalars, inline lists, and block lists, warning on a missing closing delimiter.
asNonEmptyString returns a trimmed non-empty string or undefined.
asStringArray returns a normalized string array or undefined if the input is not an array of strings.
parseCommaSeparatedList accepts an array or comma-separated string and returns trimmed non-empty items.
extractAgentClass maps a value beginning with 'TASK'→TASK or 'PERSONA'→PERSONA (case-insensitive), else undefined.
parseAgentType extracts an AGENT_TYPE in [0..2] from a body header or a markdown table cell.
parseAgentClass extracts AGENT_CLASS from a body header or markdown table cell via extractAgentClass.
getAgentInstructionPath builds <instructionRoot>/agents/AGENT_<normalizedName>.md.
readAgentInstruction resolves the instruction root, verifies read access, and throws HarnessError PERSONA_NOT_FOUND (404) when the agent file is missing.
tryReadAgentInstruction returns undefined on a PERSONA_NOT_FOUND HarnessError and rethrows other errors.
AGENT_SUBAGENT_CONTRACT_VERSION is 1.
CHILD_RUN_EVENT_TYPES = subagent.started, subagent.progress, subagent.completed, subagent.failed.

AGENT_SUBAGENT_PREREQUISITE_POSTURE blocks executable delegation, treats child definitions as contract-only and the pattern corpus runtime as reference-only, and blocks concrete provider routing and child capability inheritance.
ChildRunStatus = queued | denied | running | completed | failed | cancelled.
ChildRunCapability = read | write | shell | mcp | network | subagent.
ChildRunCapabilityPolicy forces inheritParentCapabilities:false and tracks requested, allowed, and denied capabilities.
sortedUnique trims, dedupes, drops empties, and sorts a string list.
createStableChildRunId derives a deterministic 'child_'+sha256(parentSessionId, parentTurnId, agentName, approvalRef).slice(0,16) id.
governanceAllowsAgent returns true only when the governance decision is allowed and lists the agent in delegatedSubagents.
createDelegationChildRunRecord builds a child run that is 'queued' when allowed or 'denied' otherwise, always denying all capabilities and never inheriting parent capabilities.
For an allowed delegation, governance gate is set to 'ALLOW' with a reason noting executable exposure remains blocked by prerequisite posture; otherwise the decision's gate and reason are carried.
createAdapterObservedChildRunRecord builds an 'adapter-observed' child run from observed adapter metadata, denying all capabilities and carrying the output artifact path.
providerNeutralChildRunRecord strips the adapter field from a child run record.
childRunRecordToEventData emits the provider-neutral record plus the adapter metadata when present.

validateChildRunRecord reports issues for missing childRunId/parentSessionId/agentName, capability inheritance not blocked, queued-without-allow, denied-without-deny, and completed-without-output-artifact.
delay returns a promise resolving after the given milliseconds via setTimeout.
chunkText splits text into fixed-size chunks (default 24), returning ['ok'] for empty input.
StubAgentSdkManager recognizes test markers: UNAPPROVED_DENY_TEST, UNAPPROVED_ALLOW_TEST, INTERRUPT_SIGINT_TEST, __BOOT_SDK_FAIL__, and TURN_SDK_FAIL_TEST.
StubAgentSdkManager implements IAgentSdkManager with a per-session active-turn map.
StubAgentSdkManager.interrupt throws SESSION_NOT_FOUND (404) when no active turn exists, otherwise marks the turn interrupted.
StubAgentSdkManager.startTurn yields a session:init event with a claudeSessionId (reused or generated) and the opts model.
Under the bootstrap message with model __BOOT_SDK_FAIL__, the stub yields process:exit exitCode 1.
A message containing TURN_SDK_FAIL_TEST throws HarnessError SDK_FAILURE (500).
In 'dontAsk' mode, UNAPPROVED_DENY_TEST yields a failed bash tool:result then a denial chat:complete; UNAPPROVED_ALLOW_TEST yields a successful bash tool:result.
With INTERRUPT_SIGINT_TEST, the stub keeps the turn open for up to ~4.5 seconds awaiting interruption.
The stub streams chunked chat:delta events with ~35ms delays, emitting process:exit exitCode 130 interrupted:true if interrupted mid-stream.
On normal completion the stub yields chat:complete, session:complete, then process:exit exitCode 0, always deleting the active turn in finally.
Anthropic SDK defaults: base URL https://api.anthropic.com, version 2023-06-01, max tokens 1024, stream timeout 90000ms, max inline image 5MB, fallback model claude-sonnet-4-20250514.
Outbound policy: only hostname api.anthropic.com over https: is allowed for the Anthropic API.
Supported inline image MIME types are image/png, image/jpeg, image/gif, and image/webp.
asNonEmptyString (anthropic manager) returns a trimmed non-empty string or undefined.
escapeRegExp escapes regex metacharacters in a string.
toLowercasePercentEncoding lowercases percent-encoded escape sequences in a string.
addEncodedKeyVariantCandidates and addUrlEncodedKeyVariants generate URL-encoded (and '+'-for-space) variants of an API key for redaction matching, over up to two encoding rounds.
readConfiguredApiKeys gathers the UI key, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, and CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY plus URL-encoded variants, returned sorted longest-first.
redactConfiguredApiKeys replaces any configured API key occurrence in a message with '[REDACTED_API_KEY]'.
normalizeMimeType strips parameters and lowercases a MIME type; isValidMimeTypeToken validates type/subtype token shape; isSupportedInlineImageMimeType checks the supported image set.
normalizeAnthropicBaseUrl strips trailing slashes and a trailing '/v1/messages' suffix.

validateAnthropicBaseUrl enforces REQ-NET-001: HTTPS protocol, allowlisted hostname, no credentials, and port 443 only, throwing SDK_FAILURE NETWORK_POLICY_VIOLATION on violations, and returns the origin.
getAnthropicBaseUrl reads CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_API_URL (default base URL) and validates it.
readAnthropicApiKey resolves the key with precedence UI key, then ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, then CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (OI-001/SCA-003), throwing SDK_FAILURE MISSING_API_KEY (503) when none is set.
getAnthropicVersion reads CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_VERSION or defaults to 2023-06-01.
getMaxTokens reads CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_MAX_TOKENS, defaulting to 1024 for missing/invalid/non-positive values.
getStreamTimeoutMs reads CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_STREAM_TIMEOUT_MS, defaulting to 90000ms for missing/invalid/non-positive values.
buildAnthropicClient constructs an Anthropic SDK client with apiKey, baseURL, and an anthropic-version default header.
detectMimeType prefers a valid supported fallback MIME type, otherwise infers image MIME from file extension (.png/.jpg/.jpeg/.gif/.webp), defaulting to application/octet-stream.
readImageAsBase64 reads a file, throwing ATTACHMENT_FAILURE (400) if unreadable or if it exceeds the 5MB inline image limit, and returns base64.
readPDFAsBase64 reads a file and returns base64, throwing ATTACHMENT_FAILURE (400) when unreadable.
readPlainTextDocument reads a UTF-8 file, throwing ATTACHMENT_FAILURE (400) when unreadable.

formatContentBlocks converts content blocks into Anthropic content: text blocks, base64 image blocks, base64 PDF document blocks, plain-text document blocks, and a textual fallback for unmapped types.
readEventType/readMessageStop/readTextDelta extract the event type, detect 'message_stop', and pull streamed text from delta.text, content_block.text, or event.text.
toAnthropicStreamEventError builds a SDK_FAILURE HarnessError (default 502) from a stream error event, redacting API keys in the message.
classifyHttpError maps 401/403→INVALID_API_KEY, 429→RATE_LIMITED, >=500→API_RESPONSE_ERROR, else generic API_RESPONSE_ERROR.
readErrorDetails extracts status (status/statusCode), upstream type, message, and name from an unknown error, including nested error fields.
toAnthropicSdkError converts an SDK error with a numeric status (via classifyHttpError) or named AuthenticationError/RateLimitError into a HarnessError, redacting keys.
isAbortError detects errors named 'AbortError'.
toNetworkError maps non-abort errors to a SDK_FAILURE NETWORK_ERROR (503) 'Unable to reach Anthropic API endpoint.', redacting the cause.
AnthropicAgentSdkManager implements IAgentSdkManager, injecting an AnthropicClientFactory (default buildAnthropicClient) and tracking per-session active turns.
AnthropicAgentSdkManager.interrupt throws SESSION_NOT_FOUND (404) when no active turn exists, else marks interrupted and aborts the AbortController.

AnthropicAgentSdkManager.startTurn yields session:init, then handles bootstrap and test markers, reads the API key, formats content, and streams a real Anthropic messages.create request with an abort signal and timeout.
The Anthropic turn installs a stream timeout (getStreamTimeoutMs) that aborts the request and later throws SDK_FAILURE REQUEST_TIMEOUT (504).
The Anthropic streaming request sends model (or fallback), stream:true, max_tokens, and a single user message of resolved content.
During streaming the manager yields chat:delta for text deltas, throws on 'error' events, and breaks on message_stop, then emits chat:complete/session:complete/process:exit 0.
On error the Anthropic turn emits process:exit 130 (interrupted) if interrupted, converts timeouts/SDK/network errors to HarnessError, and always clears the timeout and active turn in finally.
api-key-store (DEL-02-06) reads the UI-provided API key from a process-global set by the Electron main process storage adapter; key material MUST NOT be logged.
The UI API key process-global variable name is '__CHIRALITY_UI_API_KEY__'.
getUiApiKey returns the stored UI API key when it is a non-empty trimmed string, otherwise undefined.
hasUiApiKey returns true when getUiApiKey() is defined.
AttachmentResolver defines MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES as 10 MiB per-file limit and MAX_TOTAL_ATTACHMENT_BYTES as 18 MiB total-per-turn budget for attachments.
MIME_BY_EXTENSION maps allowed attachment extensions (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .webp, .pdf, .txt, .md, .csv) to MIME types; ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS is the set of its keys.
AttachmentResolver implements IAttachmentResolver and exposes async resolveAttachmentsToContentBlocks(message, attachmentPaths) returning ResolvedAttachments with contentBlocks and errors.
resolveAttachmentsToContentBlocks prepends a text content block containing the message when the trimmed message is non-empty.
Attachment paths that are not absolute are rejected with reason 'Attachment path must be absolute'.
Attachments whose lowercased extension is not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS are rejected as an unsupported extension, listing the allowed extensions.
Each attachment must pass an access(R_OK) readability check; ENOENT yields 'not found', EACCES/EPERM yields 'not readable'.
Attachments that are symbolic links (detected via lstat) are rejected; symbolic links are not accepted as attachments.
Attachments must reference a regular file; non-file stat results are rejected.
An attachment exceeding MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES (per-file limit) is rejected with a per-file size-limit error.
An attachment that would push totalAcceptedBytes past MAX_TOTAL_ATTACHMENT_BYTES is rejected with a per-turn size-budget error.
Accepted attachments append a content block of type 'file' with the path and resolved mimeType (defaulting to application/octet-stream).
StubAttachmentResolver extends AttachmentResolver with no behavior changes, used as a test/stub variant.
CHAT_DRAFT_STORAGE_PREFIX is the localStorage key prefix 'chirality.chatDraft.v1' for persisted chat drafts.
chat-draft defines storage warning constants for unavailable storage (in-memory only this session) and corrupt data (reset).
ChatDraftSnapshot type contains a draft string and an array of UiAttachment attachments.
buildChatDraftStorageKey(projectRoot, persona, mode) composes the storage key as PREFIX:projectRoot:persona:mode.
emptyChatDraftSnapshot returns a snapshot with empty draft string and empty attachments array.
sanitizeChatDraftSnapshot coerces unknown input into a ChatDraftSnapshot, reading the draft string and sanitizing stored attachments; non-objects yield the empty snapshot.
readChatDraftSnapshotFromStorage returns the empty snapshot with writable=false and unavailable-warning when storage.getItem throws.
readChatDraftSnapshotFromStorage returns the empty snapshot writable=true with no warning when no raw value is stored.

On JSON parse failure, readChatDraftSnapshotFromStorage removes the corrupt key and returns the empty snapshot with the corrupt-data warning; if removal also throws, returns writable=false unavailable-warning.
persistChatDraftSnapshotToStorage removes the key when the snapshot is empty, otherwise writes JSON; storage failures return writable=false with the unavailable warning.
A ChatDraftSnapshot is considered empty when both draft length and attachments length are zero.
chirality-hooks defines WRITE_HOOK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=5, SHELL_HOOK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=5, and HASH_INLINE_LIMIT_BYTES=1 MiB.
ChiralityToolHookInput carries sessionId, projectRoot, optional instructionRoot, and an optional resolveDescriptor function.
A hook descriptor is governed when it has 'workspace-write' or 'shell' permission; getHookFamily classifies it as 'shell' or 'write'.

summarizeFileState lstat-inspects a path, classifying symbolic-link/directory/other; for regular files it records byteLength and, when under HASH_INLINE_LIMIT_BYTES, a sha256 hash, otherwise omits the hash with reason 'file-too-large'.
summarizeFileState returns exists=false on ENOENT and exists=false with an error message on other failures.

allowPreToolUse returns a PreToolUse HookJSONOutput with continue=true, permissionDecision 'allow', and optional updatedInput; blockPreToolUse returns continue=false, decision 'block', permissionDecision 'deny' with reason.
createChiralityToolHooks returns hook callbacks keyed by HookEvent, maintaining a per-tool_use_id attempts Map and defaulting resolveDescriptor to getHarnessToolDescriptor.
The PreToolUse hook short-circuits (continue) for non-governed descriptors; only shell/write-governed tools are evaluated.

For shell-governed tools, PreToolUse evaluates evaluateShellCommandPolicy and blocks when not allowed, otherwise records policy metadata and allows with updatedInput, emitting DEFAULT_BASH_TIMEOUT_MS and resultBudget metadata.
For write-governed tools, PreToolUse evaluates evaluateToolPathPolicy, blocks when not allowed, otherwise records pathMetadata and a captured beforeState file summary then allows.
The PreToolUse write hook fails closed: any thrown error is logged as hook.failed and the tool is blocked with a 'failed closed' reason.

The PostToolUse hook records after-state file summary (for write tools), summarizes the tool result, persists shell result artifacts for shell tools, emits hook.completed with durationMs/resultMetadata, and deletes the attempt record.
The PostToolUseFailure hook emits hook.failed with policy/path metadata, durationMs, error, and interrupted flag, then deletes the attempt record.
createChiralityToolHooks registers PreToolUse, PostToolUse, and PostToolUseFailure matchers each with timeout = max(WRITE_HOOK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, SHELL_HOOK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS).
ClaudeAgentSdkManager pins SDK_PACKAGE_VERSION to '0.3.150'.
ClaudeAgentSdkManager implements IAgentSdkManager and AgentEnginePort with subject 'claude-agent-sdk' and tracks activeTurns by sessionId.
ClaudeAgentSdkManager constructor accepts an injectable sdkQuery (defaulting to the SDK query) and a buildSystemPrompt(projectRoot, persona, mode) function defaulting to returning empty string.

interrupt(sessionId) throws HarnessError SESSION_NOT_FOUND (404) when no active turn exists; otherwise it appends interruption.requested, sets interrupted, aborts the controller, and calls query.interrupt()/close().
startTurn is overloaded to accept either an AgentEngineRunInput or (session, message, opts, contentBlocks) and yields an AsyncIterable<UIEvent>.
When the input message trimmed equals 'bootstrap', startTurn yields a session:init event (engineSessionId/claudeSessionId/model) and a process:exit exitCode 0, then returns without running the SDK.
The bootstrap session id is derived from sdkSessionId ?? claudeSessionId ?? a generated `sdk_<uuid>`.
startTurn builds the system prompt, sdkOptions via buildSdkOptions, and sdkPrompt via buildSdkPrompt, then appends turn.accepted with provider and sdkPackageVersion before querying.
startTurn iterates the SDK stream; if interrupted mid-stream it appends interruption.completed and turn.cancelled, yields process:exit exitCode 130 interrupted=true, and returns.
Each SDK message is mapped via mapSdkMessageToHarness; harness events are appended and UI events yielded, tracking whether a terminal process:exit was seen.
If no terminal process:exit was emitted by the stream, startTurn yields a process:exit exitCode 0.
On error, if interrupted/aborted startTurn emits interruption.completed/turn.cancelled and process:exit 130; otherwise it appends turn.failed and throws HarnessError SDK_FAILURE (500).
startTurn always deletes the session from activeTurns in a finally block.
HarnessTurnStreamEvent is { event: string; data: unknown } representing a parsed SSE stream frame.
HarnessApiClientError extends Error with readonly status, code, and optional details, name 'HarnessApiClientError'.
readJson<T> attempts response.json() and returns undefined on parse failure.
fromHarnessErrorPayload builds a HarnessApiClientError from a payload, defaulting code to 'HARNESS_API_ERROR' and using payload error message/details.
requestHarnessJson fetches, throws fromHarnessErrorPayload on non-ok, throws INVALID_RESPONSE on empty body, otherwise returns the parsed payload.
parseSseFrame splits a frame into lines, reads the 'event:' name and concatenated 'data:' lines, returns null without event or data, and JSON-parses data (falling back to raw string).
openTurnStream POSTs to /api/harness/turn with JSON body, returns the response when ok, otherwise throws fromHarnessErrorPayload with 'Unable to start harness turn'.
harnessApiErrorMessage formats HarnessApiClientError as 'code: message', plain Errors as their message, else a generic failure string.
createHarnessSession POSTs to /api/harness/session/create and returns the session record.
bootHarnessSession POSTs to /api/harness/session/boot returning a SessionBootResponse.
interruptHarnessSession POSTs to /api/harness/interrupt to interrupt a session.
scaffoldHarnessExecutionRoot POSTs to /api/harness/scaffold with executionRoot, decompositionPath, optional projectName and coordinationMode, returning a ScaffoldExecutionRootResponse.

streamHarnessTurn opens a turn stream, reads the response body via a reader, decodes chunks, splits on '\n\n' frame boundaries, and invokes onEvent for each parsed SSE frame including a trailing frame.
streamHarnessTurn throws INVALID_RESPONSE when the turn response has no stream body.

EngineConformanceIssueCode enumerates STREAM_THREW, UNKNOWN_UI_EVENT, MISSING_SESSION_INIT, MISSING_ENGINE_SESSION_ID, MISSING_SESSION_INIT_MODEL, MISSING_PROCESS_EXIT, PROCESS_EXIT_NOT_TERMINAL, MISSING_INTERRUPTED_PROCESS_EXIT.
EngineConformanceOptions toggles requireSessionInit, requireEngineSessionId, and requireInterruptedProcessExit checks.
EngineConformanceReport contains subject, passed flag, events, eventTypes, and issues list.
evaluateEventStream records a STREAM_THREW issue when a thrownError is present.
evaluateEventStream flags any event whose type is not in the PUBLIC_UI_EVENT_NAMES set as UNKNOWN_UI_EVENT.
evaluateEventStream flags MISSING_SESSION_INIT when requireSessionInit is not false and no session:init event was emitted.
For each session:init event, evaluateEventStream flags MISSING_ENGINE_SESSION_ID (when required and absent) and MISSING_SESSION_INIT_MODEL when model metadata is absent.
evaluateEventStream flags MISSING_PROCESS_EXIT when no process:exit event exists, and PROCESS_EXIT_NOT_TERMINAL when process:exit is not the final event.
When requireInterruptedProcessExit is set, evaluateEventStream flags MISSING_INTERRUPTED_PROCESS_EXIT unless some process:exit has exitCode 130 and interrupted=true.
A conformance report passes only when its issues list is empty.
runEngineConformance collects all events from port.startTurn(input), captures any thrown error, and returns evaluateEventStream over them.
runEngineInterruptConformance advances the stream once, calls port.interrupt(sessionId), drains the rest, and evaluates with requireInterruptedProcessExit=true.
ERROR_COPY maps HarnessErrorType values to user-facing title/message/nextStep copy for the UI.
The ATTACHMENT_FAILURE error copy is titled 'Attachment Validation Failed' advising the user to attach readable files or include non-empty text.
The MISSING_API_KEY error copy advises setting ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and retrying the turn.
MAX_ATTACHMENT_ERROR_DETAILS limits the inline attachment-error preview to 2 entries.
parseAttachmentError validates an object with string path and reason, returning an AttachmentError or null.
parseAttachmentFailureDetails extracts a non-empty attachmentErrors array and a rejectedAttachmentCount (falling back to the parsed error count).
basenameLike returns the last path segment after splitting on slashes/backslashes, used to shorten paths in error previews.
withAttachmentFailureDetails appends a 'Rejections:' preview of up to MAX_ATTACHMENT_ERROR_DETAILS basename:reason entries plus a '(+N more)' suffix.

toHarnessUiError maps a HarnessApiClientError to its ERROR_COPY (adding attachment-failure details for ATTACHMENT_FAILURE), falls back to a generic 'Harness Request Failed', and handles non-API errors as 'Unexpected Harness Failure'.
HarnessError extends Error with readonly type (HarnessErrorType), status number, optional details, and name 'HarnessError'.

isHarnessErrorType recognizes the closed set of harness error types: INVALID_REQUEST, TURN_IN_PROGRESS, MISSING_API_KEY, PERSONA_NOT_FOUND, INSTRUCTION_ROOT_INVALID, SDK_FAILURE, SESSION_NOT_FOUND, WORKING_ROOT_INACCESSIBLE, WORKING_ROOT_CONFLICT, ATTACHMENT_FAILURE.
isHarnessErrorLike type-guards an object with a valid harness type, finite numeric status, and string message.

asHarnessError returns the error unchanged if a HarnessError, reconstructs one from a harness-error-like object, wraps a plain Error as SDK_FAILURE 500, and otherwise returns a generic SDK_FAILURE 500.

HARNESS_EVENT_TYPES is the canonical const tuple of harness event type names (session/turn/message/model/tool/hook/queue/branch/interruption/context.compaction/subagent/runtime.mirror lifecycle events).
HarnessEventType is the union of HARNESS_EVENT_TYPES values.
HarnessEvent carries schemaVersion 1, eventId, sessionId, optional turnId/parentEventId, ISO timestamp, type, and a data record.
createHarnessEvent builds a HarnessEvent with schemaVersion 1, a generated `evt_<uuid>` eventId, current ISO timestamp, and defaulting data to an empty object.
readJsonBody parses a Request JSON body and throws HarnessError INVALID_REQUEST (400) 'Request body must be valid JSON' on failure.
requireNonEmptyString throws INVALID_REQUEST (400) for non-string or blank values and returns the trimmed string otherwise.
requireStringArray throws INVALID_REQUEST (400) unless the value is an array of strings.
errorResponse converts any error via asHarnessError and returns a NextResponse JSON error body (type/message/details) with the harness error status.

formatSseEvent formats an SSE frame as 'event: <event>
data: <json>

'.
REQUIRED_FILE_ENTRIES for an instruction root: AGENTS.md, README.md, and docs/{DIRECTIVE,CONTRACT,SPEC,TYPES,PLAN}.md.
REQUIRED_DIRECTORY_ENTRIES for an instruction root are 'agents' and 'docs'.
resolveInstructionRootFromEnv returns the resolved CHIRALITY_INSTRUCTION_ROOT env path if set, else undefined.
resolveInstructionRootFromWorkspace probes cwd/.. and cwd/../../.. candidates, returning the first containing all required entries, else the first candidate.
resolveInstructionRootPath prefers the env override, otherwise resolves from the workspace.
instructionRootContainsPath returns true when targetPath resolves at or inside the instruction root (relative not starting with '..' and not absolute).

assertInstructionRootReadable verifies each required directory is a readable/executable directory and each required file is a readable file, throwing INSTRUCTION_ROOT_INVALID (500) with missing/invalid entries listed.
ChiralityReadMcpContext carries projectRoot and sessionId for read-only MCP tool execution.

Read MCP tool arg types: StatusReadArgs/DependenciesReadArgs take a deliverablePath; ScopeScanArgs is empty; ScaffoldPreviewArgs takes executionRoot, decompositionPath, optional projectName and coordinationMode.
jsonToolResult wraps a value as a CallToolResult with a single text content block containing pretty-printed JSON.
runReadMcpToolWithEvidence emits tool.started before execution and tool.completed (with durationMs and result metadata) on success, re-throwing after a best-effort tool.failed event.
assertLexicallyWithinProjectRoot throws INVALID_REQUEST (400) when a candidate path resolves outside projectRoot (lexical check, no realpath).
assertExistingPathWithinProjectRoot realpath-resolves both project root and candidate and throws INVALID_REQUEST (400) when the candidate is outside the project root.
statusReadTool reads parsed deliverable status via readDeliverableStatus under the status_read evidence wrapper.
dependenciesReadTool reads parsed deliverable dependencies via readDeliverableDependencies under the deps_read evidence wrapper.
scopeScanTool normalizes the project root and returns projectRoot, scannedAt timestamp, and scanProjectScopes results under the scope_scan wrapper.
scaffoldPreviewTool validates executionRoot lexically and decompositionPath via realpath within project root, then returns previewScaffoldExecutionRoot output.
createChiralityReadMcpServer builds an SDK MCP server named CHIRALITY_MCP_SERVER_NAME version 1.0.0 registering status_read, deps_read, scope_scan, and scaffold_preview tools with zod-validated args.
The Chirality read MCP server instructions state its tools are read-only and do not write files, run shell commands, or access networks.
createChiralityReadMcpServers returns an empty record unless at least one allowed tool name is a Chirality MCP tool, otherwise registers the read MCP server under the server name.
filterChiralityMcpAllowedToolNames filters a list down to Chirality MCP allowed tool names.
CHIRALITY_MCP_SERVER_NAME is 'chirality'.
CHIRALITY_MCP_READ_TOOL_NAMES are status_read, deps_read, scope_scan, scaffold_preview.
ChiralityMcpAllowedToolName has the form mcp__chirality__<readToolName>; CHIRALITY_MCP_ALLOWED_TOOL_NAMES derives the prefixed names.
toChiralityMcpAllowedToolName prefixes a read tool name with mcp__chirality__; isChiralityMcpAllowedToolName type-guards membership in the allowed-name set.
Harness option defaults: DEFAULT_MODEL='claude-sonnet-4-20250514', DEFAULT_TOOLS=['read','write','bash'], DEFAULT_MAX_TURNS=12.
GLOBAL_MODEL_ENV_VAR is 'CHIRALITY_GLOBAL_MODEL'; SUPPORTED_OPT_KEYS are model, tools, maxTurns, persona, mode, subagentGovernance.
asPositiveInteger returns the value only when it is a positive integer, else undefined.
readPersonaDefaults reads the persona agent instruction frontmatter and extracts tools (string array) and maxTurns (positive integer).
readGlobalModelFromInstructionRoot prefers CHIRALITY_GLOBAL_MODEL env, otherwise reads the model from the instruction root AGENTS.md frontmatter, returning undefined on failure.
warnOnUnknownOpts logs a sorted warning for opts fields not in SUPPORTED_OPT_KEYS.

resolveRuntimeOptions resolves persona/mode (opts then session), loads persona defaults and global model in parallel, and produces ResolvedOpts with model/tools/maxTurns precedence opts > persona/global > defaults.
HARNESS_PERMISSION_POLICY_VERSION is 'harness-permission.v3.bash'.
Harness permission decision values are 'allow' | 'deny' | 'ask'; decision sources include sdk-option, sdk-callback, chirality-policy, hook, human, prompt-support.
NormalizedHarnessPermissionMode is one of readOnly, workspaceWrite, dontAsk, ask, bypass.
normalizeHarnessPermissionMode maps known mode strings to their normalized value and defaults unknown modes to 'ask'.

createDecision builds a HarnessPermissionDecision with a generated perm_<uuid> id, defaulted sessionId, chirality-policy default source, ISO decidedAt, and safeMetadata embedding policy version, mode, and descriptor summary fields.
resolveHarnessPermissionDecision denies (hardDeny) when explicitDeny is set, when the descriptor is unknown, or when the descriptor surface is 'reserved'.
For shell-permission tools, resolveHarnessPermissionDecision allows in workspaceWrite mode (requiresHookApproval), asks in ask mode, and denies in other modes.
Tools with 'danger' permission are hard-denied; tools with 'network' permission are hard-denied pending a future governed tranche.
Tools with 'subagent' permission are hard-denied pending governed SDK agent definitions and fail-closed hooks.
For workspace-write tools, resolveHarnessPermissionDecision allows in workspaceWrite mode (requiresHookApproval), asks in ask mode, and denies in other modes.
Tools with 'read' permission are allowed in the current mode; tools with no supported permission class are denied as 'unsupported-permission'.
permissionDecisionToSdkResult maps an allow decision to behavior 'allow', and ask/deny to behavior 'deny' (ask adds an application-approval-required message).
appendPermissionDecisionEvent emits a tool.permission harness event carrying behavior, decisionId, reason, source, toolName, mode, descriptor summary, and safeMetadata.

createHarnessCanUseTool returns a CanUseTool callback that evaluates path policy (and shell policy for shell tools), builds a permission decision (denying on policy failure), appends the decision event, and denies on audit-append failure.
StubPersonaManager implements IPersonaManager: buildSystemPrompt ensures the persona exists then returns 'Persona=<persona>; mode=<mode>; projectRoot=<root>'.
StubPersonaManager.getBootFingerprint returns the first 32 hex chars of sha256('<persona>::<mode>').
escapeRegExp escapes regex metacharacters in a string for safe use in a RegExp.
toLowercasePercentEncoding lowercases percent-encoded sequences (%XX) in a string.
addEncodedKeyVariantCandidates adds an encoded key and its lowercased form to the variant set, plus query-style '+' variants when %20 is present.
addUrlEncodedKeyVariants iterates two rounds of URL-encoding to accumulate API-key encoding variants for redaction matching.
readConfiguredApiKeyVariants collects configured keys (UI key, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), expands URL-encoded variants, and returns them sorted by descending length.
redactConfiguredApiKeys replaces all occurrences of any configured API-key variant in a message with '[REDACTED_API_KEY]'.
redactJsonLike recursively redacts API keys from strings, arrays, and object values while preserving structure.
HarnessRuntime aggregates sessionManager, personaManager, attachmentResolver, agentSdkManager, and turnEngine.
The harness runtime is cached on globalThis under __CHIRALITY_HARNESS_RUNTIME__.
HarnessProviderMode is 'stub' | 'anthropic' | 'agentSdk'.
resolveHarnessProviderMode reads CHIRALITY_HARNESS_PROVIDER: agentsdk/agent-sdk/claude-agent-sdk -> agentSdk, anthropic -> anthropic, else stub.
buildAgentSdkManager returns AnthropicAgentSdkManager for anthropic, ClaudeAgentSdkManager (wired to the global persona manager's buildSystemPrompt) for agentSdk, else StubAgentSdkManager.
getHarnessRuntime lazily constructs and caches the runtime (FileSessionManager, StubPersonaManager, AttachmentResolver, provider-selected agent SDK manager, and a TurnEngine).
resetHarnessRuntimeForTests deletes the cached global runtime to reset state between tests.
sanitize defines ILLEGAL_LABEL_CHARACTERS regex matching / \ : * ? " < > | and CONSECUTIVE_WHITESPACE matching runs of whitespace.
sanitizeLabel (SPEC 10.1) replaces illegal filesystem characters with '-', collapses consecutive whitespace to one space, and trims.
sanitizeNonEmptyLabel sanitizes a label and throws INVALID_REQUEST (400) when the result is empty.
scaffold defines PKG_ID_PATTERN /^PKG-\d{2,3}$/ and DEL_ID_PATTERN /^DEL-\d{2,3}-\d{2}$/ for package and deliverable IDs.

EXECUTION_ROOT_DIRECTORIES enumerates the top-level execution-root folders (_Aggregation, _Change, _Coordination, _Decomposition, _Estimates, _Reconciliation, _Archive, _Scripts, _Sources and archive/template subdirs).
REQUIRED_PACKAGE_SUBDIRECTORIES define the per-package folder layout: 0_References, 1_Working, 2_Checking (From/To), 3_Issued and their _Archive subdirs.
PREPARATION_REQUIRED_METADATA_FILES are _STATUS.md, _CONTEXT.md, _DEPENDENCIES.md, _REFERENCES.md, _SEMANTIC.md.
COORDINATION_MODES are SCHEDULE_FIRST, DEPENDENCY_TRACKED, HYBRID; CoordinationMode is their union type.
LayoutValidationResult reports executionRoot validity plus per-package and per-deliverable validity with missing-path lists.
PreparationCompatibilityResult reports overall readiness, deliverablesChecked count, issueCount, and per-deliverable issue lists.
ScaffoldFailureStage enumerates the ordered scaffolding stages used for fail-fast error context (ensure_execution_root through validate_preparation_compatibility).
withScaffoldFailureContext wraps an error into a HarnessError carrying FAIL_FAST strategy, failing stage, targetPath, created directories/files, and guidance, preserving existing detail fields.
requireAbsolutePath throws INVALID_REQUEST (400) for missing/blank input or non-absolute paths and returns the resolved absolute path.
parseMarkdownTableRow parses a pipe-delimited markdown table row into trimmed cells, returning null for non-table or separator rows.
extractProjectName takes the first '# ' heading, strips the marker, splits on an em-dash/hyphen separator, and returns the leading segment (defaulting to 'Chirality Project').
parseDecomposition scans markdown for PKG headings/rows and DEL rows under the current package, deduplicating by ID, and returns sorted packages with their deliverables.
parseDecomposition throws INVALID_REQUEST (400) when no parseable packages or deliverables are found.
parseCoordinationMode defaults undefined to DEPENDENCY_TRACKED and throws INVALID_REQUEST (400) for non-string or unrecognized coordination modes.
buildPackagePlans maps each package to a sanitized '<id>_<label>' folder with its required subdirectories and per-deliverable paths under 1_Working as '<id>_<label>'.
getPlannedDirectories assembles the full planned directory list: execution root, execution-root subdirs, and each package's expected and deliverable paths.
ensureDirectory verifies an existing path is a directory (throwing WORKING_ROOT_INACCESSIBLE 409 if a file), and creates it recursively on ENOENT, tracking created directories.
ensureFile is a no-op if the file exists, otherwise writes UTF-8 content and tracks the created file; non-ENOENT access errors raise SDK_FAILURE 500.
findMissingPaths returns the subset of paths failing an F_OK access check; pathExists returns a boolean for a single path.

previewScaffoldExecutionRoot validates absolute paths, reads/parses the decomposition markdown, and returns planned directories, files (copied decomposition, INIT.md, _COORDINATION.md), and package plans without writing.
buildInitTemplate produces the INIT.md content with project name, ISO date, decomposition reference, coordination mode, and a Session Parameters section.
buildCoordinationTemplate produces _COORDINATION.md with the representation, FULL_GRAPH dependency tracking, the list of coordination representations, and selection notes.
validateLayout checks the execution root expected paths plus per-package and per-deliverable expected paths, returning validity and missing-path lists.
validatePreparationCompatibility checks each deliverable directory exists/is writable and that any present PREPARATION metadata files are writable non-directories, aggregating issues and readiness.

scaffoldExecutionRoot validates inputs, parses the decomposition, then sequentially ensures execution-root dirs, copies the decomposition, writes INIT.md and _COORDINATION.md, creates package/subdir/deliverable directories, and runs layout and preparation-compatibility validation.
scaffoldExecutionRoot copies the decomposition only when the copied path differs from the source path, skipping copy if the target already exists.
scaffoldExecutionRoot tracks failureStage/failurePath through each step and wraps any thrown error with withScaffoldFailureContext for fail-fast diagnostics.
The generated INIT.md template includes a 'Session Parameters' section instructing users to add project-specific startup constraints.
The generated _COORDINATION.md template lists coordination representations SCHEDULE_FIRST, DEPENDENCY_TRACKED, HYBRID.
The generated _COORDINATION.md selection notes state the full dependency graph remains audit truth while a blocker subset may serve as execution sequencing truth per project policy.
Exports type SdkMessageMapping with uiEvents (UIEvent[]), harnessEvents (HarnessEvent[]), optional sdkSessionId and sdkClaudeCodeVersion.
Exports type SdkToolEvidenceState tracking toolNamesByUseId (Map<string,string>) and startedToolUseIds (Set<string>).
createSdkToolEvidenceState() returns a fresh SdkToolEvidenceState with empty Map and Set.
readSessionId reads a message's session_id string field; readMessageId reads its uuid field.
isSdkBuiltinEvidenceDescriptor treats a descriptor as evidence-bearing only when surface is 'claude-agent-sdk-builtin' and it has read, workspace-write, or shell permission.
isChiralityMcpTool returns true when the tool's descriptor surface is 'chirality-mcp' or the tool name is a Chirality MCP allowed tool name.
registerQueuedToolUse records a toolUseId->toolName mapping in the evidence state when both are present.
createInferredToolStartedEvent emits a single 'tool.started' event per toolUseId, deduplicating via startedToolUseIds so a start is inferred at most once.
readToolUsesFromContent extracts tool-use evidence from content blocks of type 'tool_use' or 'server_tool_use', returning id, name, and input.
sdkEvidence builds redacted adapter evidence (adapterName 'claude-agent-sdk', adapter/sdk session and message ids) merged with extra data.
mapSdkUserToolResultEvents emits tool lifecycle events from tool_use_result only when the tool is a known SDK builtin evidence descriptor and not a Chirality MCP tool.
A tool_use_result is mapped to 'tool.failed' when isToolResultFailure is true, otherwise 'tool.completed'.
Shell-descriptor tool results additionally attach summarizeShellResultStreams metadata.
mapSdkUserMessage emits a user 'message.completed' event and enqueues a 'queue.enqueued' event when shouldQuery is false or priority is 'next'/'later'.
isSystemInit/isCompactBoundary/isPermissionDenied/isMirrorError are type guards keyed on message.type 'system' and the respective subtype.
Exports mapSdkMessageToHarness(sessionId, message, state) which dispatches SDK messages to UI and harness events by message type.
A system 'init' message yields a 'session:init' UI event and an 'adapter.initialized' harness event carrying model, tools, mcpServers, and permissionMode.
A 'stream_event' message yields 'chat:delta' UI events for text deltas and 'model.delta'/'message.delta' harness events, plus 'tool.queued' for streamed tool_use starts.
An 'assistant' message yields 'chat:delta' for text and 'message.completed' plus per-tool 'tool.queued' harness events.
A successful 'result' message yields 'chat:complete', 'session:complete', and 'process:exit' (exitCode 0) UI events plus 'model.completed' and 'turn.completed' harness events.
A successful result with deferred_tool_use registers the deferred tool and emits a 'tool.queued' harness event with queueReason 'deferred_tool_use'.
A failed 'result' yields a 'process:exit' UI event with exitCode 1, errorType 'SDK_FAILURE', status 500, fatal true, and a 'turn.failed' harness event.
A permission_denied message yields a 'tool:result' UI event (ok false) and both 'tool.permission' (deny) and 'tool.failed' (failureSource 'permission') harness events.
A compact_boundary message yields a 'context.compacted' harness event with replayImplication 'sdk_transcript_linkage_required'.
A 'tool_progress' message emits an inferred 'tool.started' for SDK builtin evidence descriptors plus a 'tool.progress' harness event with elapsed time and taskId.
A 'tool_use_summary' emits a 'tool.completed' harness event unless every preceding tool use was a Chirality MCP tool, in which case no event is emitted.
hook_started/hook_progress/hook_response system subtypes map to hook.started/hook.progress and hook.completed-or-failed harness events.

A system 'status' message maps status 'requesting' to model.request.started, 'compacting' to context.compaction.started, and compact_result success/failed to context.compacted/context.compaction.failed.
task_started/task_progress/task_updated/task_notification system subtypes map to subagent.started/progress/completed/failed harness events.
task_updated maps patch.status 'completed' to subagent.completed, 'failed'/'killed' to subagent.failed, otherwise subagent.progress.
Unrecognized message types yield empty uiEvents and harnessEvents arrays (no-op fallthrough).
Exports type SdkProbeOptions extending SDK Options with a required settingSources: SettingSource[].
parseSettingSources returns ['project'] only when the raw env value is exactly the single token 'project', otherwise an empty array.

mapPermissionMode maps normalized 'readOnly'/'dontAsk' to 'dontAsk', 'workspaceWrite' to 'acceptEdits', and 'bypass' (only when CHIRALITY_ALLOW_SDK_BYPASS==='1') to 'bypassPermissions', else 'default'.
contentBlocksToPrompt appends a text/attachment summary to the message; file blocks render as '[Attachment: <path> (<mimeType>)]'.
Exports buildSdkPrompt(message, contentBlocks) which delegates to contentBlocksToPrompt.
Exports buildSdkOptions which resolves the tool pool, derives allowed Chirality MCP tool names, and assembles SDK Options.
buildSdkOptions sets cwd to session.projectRoot, applies tools/allowedTools/disallowedTools from the resolved pool, and wires canUseTool, hooks, and Chirality read MCP servers.
buildSdkOptions sets resume to session.sdkSessionId and systemPrompt as a preset 'claude_code' with the supplied systemPrompt appended.
Session event files live under CHIRALITY_SESSION_ROOT or <cwd>/.chirality/sessions, with per-session events.jsonl.
appendHarnessEvent creates the session directory and appends a redacted JSON line to events.jsonl, returning the file path.
replayHarnessEvents reads events.jsonl, parses each non-empty line as a HarnessEvent, and returns events plus a malformedLineCount; a missing file yields empty events.
Default persona is 'WORKING_ITEMS' and default mode is 'direct' for new sessions.

assertProjectRootAccessible requires an absolute path, rejects roots inside the instruction root (WORKING_ROOT_CONFLICT 409), and verifies the directory exists and is R/W accessible (WORKING_ROOT_INACCESSIBLE 404).
readSessionFromDisk reads <sessionId>.json and throws SESSION_NOT_FOUND (404) when the file is missing or unparseable.
Exports FileSessionManager implementing ISessionManager with filesystem-backed session storage.
FileSessionManager.create assigns a sessionId of 'sess_'+randomUUID, sets createdAt/updatedAt, and writes the session JSON.
FileSessionManager.save merges updates while preserving sessionId and createdAt and refreshing updatedAt.
FileSessionManager.list returns sessions whose resolved projectRoot matches the requested root, sorted ascending by createdAt, ignoring malformed records.
Exports type GovernanceGateId enumerating gates: ENVIRONMENT, PERSONA_ALLOWLIST, METADATA_PRESENCE, CONTEXT_SEALED, PIPELINE_RUN_APPROVED, APPROVAL_REF, INTERNAL_ERROR, ALLOW.
Exports type SubagentGovernanceDecision with allowed, gate, reason, evaluationMs, allowlistedSubagents, delegatedSubagents, and optional approvalRef/approvedBy.
resolveDelegatedSubagents rejects candidate subagents whose instruction file is missing or whose AGENT_TYPE is not 2, and warns (but allows) when AGENT_CLASS is not 'TASK'.
Exports async evaluateSubagentGovernance(persona, subagentGovernance, env) returning a fail-closed SubagentGovernanceDecision.
Governance denies at ENVIRONMENT gate unless env.CHIRALITY_ENABLE_SUBAGENTS === 'true'.
Governance denies at PERSONA_ALLOWLIST gate when the persona's frontmatter lists no allowlisted subagents.
Governance denies at CONTEXT_SEALED gate unless subagentGovernance.contextSealed is strictly true, and at PIPELINE_RUN_APPROVED unless pipelineRunApproved is strictly true.
Governance denies at APPROVAL_REF gate unless subagentGovernance.approvalRef is a non-empty string.
On passing all gates, governance returns allowed=true gate 'ALLOW' with resolved delegatedSubagents, approvalRef, and approvedBy.
Any thrown error during evaluation is caught and converted to an INTERNAL_ERROR deny decision (fail-closed).
logDecision logs an ALLOW or DENY line with persona, gate, and evaluationMs; maybeWarnOnSlowEvaluation warns when evaluationMs exceeds CHIRALITY_SUBAGENT_GOVERNANCE_WARN_MS.
Exports HARNESS_TOOL_REGISTRY_VERSION = 'harness-tools.v5.bash'.
Exports type ClaudeAgentSdkBuiltinToolName union: Read, Glob, Grep, LS, Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit, Bash, WebFetch, WebSearch, Agent.
Exports type HarnessToolPermission union: read, workspace-write, network, shell, subagent, danger.
Exports HarnessToolPathScope union: none, project-root-read, project-root-write, instruction-root-read, external-network.
HarnessToolHumanGate is either {required:false} or {required:true, gate, reason} with gate in interactive-confirmation | approval-sha | future-policy.

Exports type HarnessToolDescriptor capturing name, aliases, surface, permissions, pathScope, idempotence, concurrency, interruptBehavior, resultBudget, provenance, humanGate, adapter, schemas, and runtime support.
Read result budget is 64KiB inline / 2MiB artifact; write budget 16KiB inline / 512KiB artifact; shell budget 16KiB inline / 2MiB artifact; all overflow to artifact.
readOnlyDescriptor factory builds read-permission SDK-builtin descriptors (project-root-read, idempotent, safe concurrency, no human gate, SDK_READ_RUNTIME).
chiralityReadMcpDescriptor factory builds read-only chirality-mcp descriptors, adding the MCP tool name and its allowed form to aliases.
Exports HARNESS_TOOL_DESCRIPTORS registering read_file/find_files/search_files/list_files (SDK read) and status_read/deps_read/scope_scan/scaffold_preview (Chirality read MCP).
write_file, edit_file, and multi_edit_file are workspace-write, mutating, serialized-by-path, block-on-interrupt descriptors requiring an interactive-confirmation human gate.
notebook_edit is a 'reserved' surface (workspace-write+danger) gated behind future-policy and not exposed to the model (DESCRIPTOR_ONLY_RUNTIME).
The 'shell' (Bash) descriptor carries permissions shell+workspace-write+danger, exclusive concurrency, and requires an interactive-confirmation human gate.
web_fetch and web_search are reserved network descriptors gated behind future-policy and not exposed to the model under the Anthropic-only runtime policy.
The 'agent' (subagent) descriptor has permission 'subagent', emits subagent lifecycle events, and is gated behind future-policy (descriptor-only).
createDescriptorLookup builds a case-insensitive Map keyed by descriptor name, each alias, and the SDK tool name.
Exports listHarnessToolDescriptors, getHarnessToolDescriptor (by normalized name/alias), and getKnownHarnessToolNames.
getCurrentTrancheDisallowedToolNames returns every descriptor's SDK tool name not present in the allowed set.
Exports resolveHarnessToolPool which resolves requested tools to descriptors, evaluates permission decisions, and partitions into allowed, disallowed, denied, and unknown tools.

A requested tool joins allowedToolNames only when its permission decision is 'allow', the descriptor is exposedToModel, and it has an SDK tool name; otherwise it is recorded as DENIED_BY_CURRENT_PHASE.
SAFE_PATH_FIELD_NAMES whitelists file_path, path, deliverablePath, executionRoot, decompositionPath, projectRoot for evidence capture.
Exports type ToolInputEvidence (inputType, inputKeys, pathFields) and ToolResultEvidence with byte lengths, content types, budget limits, and a budgetClass.
Exports type ToolResultBudgetClass: unknown-descriptor, within-inline-budget, requires-artifact-overflow, exceeds-artifact-budget.
Exports type ShellResultStreamEvidence describing stdout/stderr presence and byte lengths, interruption, background-task, and sandbox flags.
classifyResultBudget compares result byte length against the descriptor's inline and artifact limits to assign a ToolResultBudgetClass; no descriptor yields 'unknown-descriptor'.
summarizeToolInput returns inputType, sorted inputKeys, and redacted pathFields restricted to the safe path field whitelist.

summarizeToolResult computes result byte length, content item count, content text byte length, distinct content types, and budget classification; it never persists output (outputPersisted/rawOutputPersisted false).
summarizeShellResultStreams reports stdout/stderr presence and byte lengths and flags backgroundTask, interrupted, isImage, rawOutputPathPresent, and dangerouslyDisableSandbox.
summarizeToolDescriptor projects a descriptor to name, adapter tool name, surface, permissions, pathScope, humanGate, and resultBudget.
summarizeToolError normalizes Error instances and record-like errors into a redacted {errorName, message, type, status}.
isToolResultFailure returns true when a record result has is_error===true or isError===true.
Exports HarnessToolPathPolicyResult as a discriminated union of allowed (with allow metadata) and denied (with reason and metadata).
PRIMARY_PATH_FIELDS scans file_path, path, notebook_path, deliverablePath, executionRoot, decompositionPath for the path subject.
isWithinRoot returns true when the candidate resolves to or under the root (relative path is empty or non-'..' and not absolute).
resolveToolPath resolves absolute raw paths directly and relative paths against the project root.
rejectSymlinkWritePath walks each path segment from the project root and denies (symlink-write) if any component is a symbolic link.
A missing project root segment yields project-root-missing deny; deeper ENOENT segments are allowed (path not yet created).
Exports async evaluateToolPathPolicy which denies a pre-blocked SDK path, allows tools without project-root read/write scope, and enforces containment for scoped tools.
A resolved path outside the active project root is denied with denyClass 'path-containment'.
For write-scope tools, paths under the instruction root are denied (instruction-root) and symlink-crossing write paths are rejected before allowing.
Exports type ToolResultArtifactMetadata with artifactPath, artifactRelativePath, byte lengths, redacted:true, and truncated flag.
persistToolResultArtifact only persists when the descriptor budget overflow is 'artifact'; returns undefined otherwise.
An artifact is written only when the redacted serialized result exceeds the descriptor's inline byte limit.
Results exceeding the artifact byte limit are persisted truncated, storing only a preview sliced to the inline byte limit plus originalByteLength.
Tool result artifacts are written under <sessionRoot>/<sessionId>/artifacts/tools/<toolUseId>-<toolName>.json with sanitized path segments.
Exports HARNESS_SHELL_POLICY_VERSION='harness-shell.v1.bash', DEFAULT_BASH_TIMEOUT_MS=120000, MAX_BASH_TIMEOUT_MS=600000.
NETWORK_COMMANDS denylist covers curl, ftp, nc, netcat, rsync, scp, sftp, ssh, telnet, wget.
firstCommandWord extracts the command name, skipping leading VAR=value environment assignments.
extractRedirectionTargets parses shell redirection targets and extractAbsolutePathTokens collects absolute path tokens from the command.
Exports async evaluateShellCommandPolicy returning an allow/deny result for a Bash command.
Shell policy denies a missing/empty command (missing-command) and denies when no project root is present (project-root-missing).
Shell timeout defaults to DEFAULT_BASH_TIMEOUT_MS; non-positive or non-integer timeouts are denied (invalid-timeout) and timeouts above MAX_BASH_TIMEOUT_MS are denied (timeout-too-large).
Shell policy denies dangerouslyDisableSandbox (sandbox-override) and run_in_background (background-command).
Shell policy denies network-capable command names, embedded http/ws/ftp URLs (network-url), and parent-directory traversal (path-traversal).
Shell policy denies absolute path tokens that resolve outside the project root (path-containment) or under the instruction root (instruction-root).
Redirection targets are each validated through evaluateToolPathPolicy and denied as redirection-path on failure.
When no timeout was requested, the policy returns updatedInput injecting timeout=DEFAULT_BASH_TIMEOUT_MS.
Exports TOOLKIT_STORAGE_KEY='chirality.toolkit.v1'.
Exports type ToolkitValues (model, tools, maxTurns, includeSubagentGovernance, contextSealed, pipelineRunApproved, approvalRef) and ToolkitPreset/ToolkitState types.
MAX_PRESET_COUNT caps stored toolkit presets at 25.
defaultToolkitValues and defaultToolkitState return empty/false defaults with no presets and no selection.
sanitizeToolkitValues coerces an unknown record into typed ToolkitValues, trimming strings and booleanizing flags.
sanitizePreset rejects entries lacking id or name and defaults createdAt/updatedAt; sanitizeToolkitState caps presets to MAX_PRESET_COUNT and clears a selectedPresetId that no longer exists.

buildHarnessOptsFromToolkit builds HarnessOpts from toolkit values, splitting tools on newlines/commas, parsing maxTurns, and including subagentGovernance only when enabled; returns undefined when no options set.
createToolkitPreset assigns id 'preset-<epochMs>-<rand>' with sanitized values; upsertToolkitPreset replaces by id and caps to MAX_PRESET_COUNT, newest first.
DEFAULT_SDK_PACKAGE_VERSION defaults to '0.3.150'.
Exports type TurnEngineProviderMode: 'stub' | 'anthropic' | 'agentSdk'.
Exports type RunningHarnessTurn with sessionId, an AsyncIterable<UIEvent> events stream, and a cancel() method.
Exports type TurnEngineDependencies injecting session/persona/attachment/agentSdk managers and optional overrides for provider mode, API-key check, env, sdk version, and option/governance resolvers.
parseTurnRequest validates the request body as an object, requires a non-empty sessionId and string message, and requires attachments to be a string array.
assertKnownAgentSdkTools throws INVALID_REQUEST (400) listing any unknown harness tools resolved from the requested tools.
Exports class TurnEngine which serializes turns per session via an activeSessionTurns set.
TurnEngine.runTurn resumes the session, and for anthropic/agentSdk provider modes throws MISSING_API_KEY (503) when no Anthropic API key is configured.
runTurn throws TURN_IN_PROGRESS (409) if a turn is already active for the session, and always releases the turn lock on error.
In agentSdk mode runTurn calls assertKnownAgentSdkTools before resolving attachments.
runTurn throws ATTACHMENT_FAILURE (400) when there is no text and no executable (file) attachment.
runTurn evaluates subagent governance and attaches delegatedSubagents to effective opts only when governance allows, else an empty list.
The returned turn's cancel() interrupts the agent SDK best-effort and always releases the turn lock.
hasAnthropicApiKeyConfigured is true if the UI key check passes or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set.

streamTurn persists session:init metadata (engineSessionId, claudeSessionId, model, and sdkSessionId/sdkPackageVersion in agentSdk mode), and on error yields turn:error then process:exit (exitCode 1).
classifyStreamErrorSeverity returns 'error' for status >= 500 and 'warning' otherwise.
buildAttachmentWarningText summarizes up to MAX_ATTACHMENT_WARNING_DETAILS (3) rejected attachments with an omitted-count line for the remainder.

Exports type HarnessErrorType union of error codes including INVALID_REQUEST, TURN_IN_PROGRESS, MISSING_API_KEY, SESSION_NOT_FOUND, SDK_FAILURE, WORKING_ROOT_INACCESSIBLE/CONFLICT, ATTACHMENT_FAILURE.
Exports interface SessionRecord with sessionId, projectRoot, persona, mode, timestamps, and optional SDK/engine session linkage fields.
Exports type CoordinationMode: 'SCHEDULE_FIRST' | 'DEPENDENCY_TRACKED' | 'HYBRID'.
Exports scaffold request/response interfaces including ScaffoldExecutionRootResponse with layoutValidation and preparationCompatibility.
Exports interface HarnessOpts with optional model, tools, maxTurns, persona, mode, subagentGovernance.
Exports interface ResolvedOpts with required model, tools, maxTurns, persona, mode plus optional subagentGovernance and delegatedSubagents.

This document is the authoritative catalog of binding invariants for Chirality App; listed invariants are enforceable constraints that agents, tooling, implementation code, governance documents, human processes, and release operations must respect.
Enforcement may occur in code, tests, release checks, instructions, human gates, or the reliance-boundary register.
Prompt text alone is not sufficient enforcement for P0 safety, audit, filesystem, or human-gate boundaries.
Invariant IDs (K-*) are stable and never reused; retired invariants move to Section 4 with retirement rationale.
K-PRD-1: docs/PRD.md is the approved vNext product-direction source for the current runtime posture; the synchronized governance set controls operations once updated.
K-HIER-1: Projects are decomposed as flat packages containing deliverables; packages do not nest and there is no phase or sub-package layer inside the project hierarchy.
K-ID-1: Stable identifiers are identity; package, deliverable, dependency, scope, objective, session, turn, and event IDs persist across renames, path changes, and UI labels.
K-PATH-1: Path is a physical projection of identity, not identity itself; runtime records and project files must preserve stable IDs when paths change.
K-FS-1: Project truth lives in plain files under the working root and accepted git history, not in hidden app state, chats, SDK transcripts, model context, or vendor systems.
K-GIT-1: Accepted project decisions bind to versioned files; gate-relevant decisions not represented in git-tracked project artifacts are not reliance evidence.
K-NOMEM-1: No hidden memory may become authoritative project state; runtime convenience state is allowed only when explicitly non-authoritative.

K-AUTH-1: Only humans author binding approval records; no agent, SDK, tool, runtime event, validator, or domain adapter may certify, approve, sign, seal, issue, transmit, or externally validate work for reliance.
K-AUTH-2: Human approvals bind to specific content evidence, normally a git SHA; content changes after approval void the approval until re-reviewed.
K-BIND-1: Binding and non-binding records must not be conflated; drafts, proposals, summaries, and runtime transcripts are not approval records.
K-GATE-1: Human gates are non-delegable; CHECKING, ISSUED, domain-operation acceptance, and other reliance-affecting states require accountable human evidence.
K-PROF-1: Chirality must not claim code compliance, external validation, solver truth, or professional adequacy by itself.
K-ROOT-1: Instruction root and working root are separate; the working root must not be inside the instruction root.
K-ROOT-2: Ordinary project execution must not mutate the instruction root; instruction-root writes require governed release/change operations.
K-ROOT-3: The working root is the only ordinary location where agents may write project truth.
K-PACKAGE-1: Packaged builds must contain the required instruction-root resources and verify integrity before distribution.
K-CORE-1: Core runtime APIs, events, tests, and records use Chirality terms; provider/SDK-specific terms are translated at adapter boundaries.
K-ENGINE-1: Chirality owns AgentEnginePort / RuntimeEngineContract; provider and SDK APIs do not define public harness semantics.
K-ENGINE-2: Any provider/SDK-backed adapter must pass engine conformance tests before becoming the default production path.

K-ENGINE-3: External SDKs and providers are implementation substrates behind Chirality adapters, not product identity or governance authority; Claude Agent SDK / Anthropic is the first concrete adapter and current shipped path.
K-ENGINE-4: Public APIs, UIEvent, HarnessEvent, session storage, permission decisions, and governance records must not become provider/SDK-shaped except as adapter metadata.
K-ENGINE-5: A governed fallback/custom-runtime path must remain available if a product-critical boundary cannot be satisfied or verified through the current adapter.
K-RELIANCE-1: Product-critical safety, audit, filesystem, lifecycle, transcript, settings, subagent, and human-gate boundaries must be mapped in the reliance-boundary register.
K-RELIANCE-2: P0 reliance boundaries cannot be prompt-only or opaque provider/SDK-default-only.
K-SDK-1: Shipped builds for the Claude Agent SDK / Anthropic adapter must not load ambient user/global Claude Code settings or local .claude/settings.local.json.
K-SDK-2: Provider/SDK adapter behavior must be version-pinned and regression-tested on upgrade.
K-SDK-3: SDK transcripts are resume/debug artifacts, not canonical Chirality audit records unless explicitly imported into HarnessEvent form.
K-SDK-4: Product identity remains Chirality; the app must not appear to be Claude Code or an Anthropic product.
K-EVENT-1: Browser UIEvents and persisted HarnessEvents are separate contracts; UI events remain stable and compact while persisted events may be richer and versioned.
K-EVENT-2: Accepted user input must be persisted before model/SDK execution begins; a killed or interrupted process must leave a recoverable accepted-turn event.
K-EVENT-3: Every accepted turn must end with a durable success, failure, cancellation, or interruption event.
K-EVENT-4: .chirality/sessions/<id>/events.jsonl is the product-owned Chirality runtime audit mirror.
K-EVENT-5: JSONL event replay must tolerate malformed trailing lines and preserve valid prior events.
K-EVENT-6: Runtime events, run logs, tool artifacts, and provider errors must redact secrets and avoid storing API keys.
K-EVENT-7: Large or sensitive tool results must be budgeted, previewed, stored as artifacts, or redacted according to policy.

K-PERM-1: Permission governance is capability-forward and policy-mediated; useful agent tool use may be exposed when mode, adapter, descriptor, hook, evidence, and human-gate policy allow it, and explicit hard denies override allows.
K-PERM-2: Prompt text is not a safety boundary; filesystem writes, tool exposure, bash, subagents, and domain operations require runtime enforcement.

K-PERM-3: Tool availability or allowedTools alone is not a restriction boundary; restriction requires explicit deny precedence, disallowed tools, mode policy, hooks, canUseTool, and/or dontAsk posture.
K-PERM-4: readOnly mode must not expose or allow write/edit/bash/network-capable actions.
K-PERM-5: dontAsk mode denies unapproved writes, shell, network, and unknown tools without prompting.
K-PERM-6: bypassPermissions is developer-local only and never shipped as ordinary operator behavior; Chirality deny hooks still apply.
K-TOOL-1: Tool exposure is deterministic for a given session, persona, mode, option set, SDK version, MCP server set, and permission policy.
K-TOOL-2: Tool implementation availability does not imply model exposure; a tool must pass tool-surface and permission resolution before exposure.
K-MCP-1: MCP is a transport, not a bypass; in-process Chirality MCP tools pass through the same permission, hook, path, redaction, and event logging policy as SDK built-ins.
K-HOOK-1: Hook failures fail closed for write, shell, domain, and subagent actions.
K-PATH-2: Runtime tools must enforce working-root containment and reject writes outside the active project root.
K-PATH-3: Symlink writes are rejected in the initial policy; any relaxation requires governed amendment and tests.

K-BASH-1: Bash is unavailable unless an explicitly governed mode enables it after timeout, output capture, result storage, interrupt behavior, and audit events are validated, and this bash gate must not suppress unrelated safe read/tool capabilities.
K-STATUS-1: _STATUS.md is the canonical human-readable lifecycle state file for each deliverable; no other file determines deliverable state.
K-STATUS-2: Lifecycle transitions are forward-only and actor-authorized; transitions to human-gate states require approval SHA evidence.
K-DEP-1: Deliverable-local _DEPENDENCIES.md and Dependencies.csv are authoritative for dependencies; aggregation is on-demand, not a separate central truth store.
K-DEP-2: Dependency references to deliverables must resolve to existing stable deliverable IDs; unresolvable targets use TargetType=UNKNOWN.
K-PROV-1: Active extracted dependency rows must cite evidence: EvidenceFile plus SourceRef, or explicit location TBD.
K-INVENT-1: Unknown values become TBD, not guesses; agents and tools must not invent scope items, dependency targets, parameters, or professional conclusions.
K-CONFLICT-1: Source conflicts are surfaced, not silently resolved.
K-SNAP-1: Snapshot-producing workflows write immutable timestamped folders; mutable _LATEST.md pointers may move but snapshots must not be overwritten.
K-REF-1: Accepted reference hash tooling and dependency-linter tooling remain available; retired hardening scope is not reintroduced by runtime event logging.
K-WRITE-1: Every agent instruction file declares explicit write scope; agents must not write outside their declared scope.
K-SEAL-1: Type 2 task-agent execution requires sealed context and gate approval metadata.
K-GHOST-1: Type 2 task-agent context is limited to folder contents and declared references; no ghost inputs.
K-SUBAGENT-1: Subagent delegation fails closed unless environment enablement, persona allowlist, context sealing, pipeline approval, approval reference, and Type 2 eligibility all pass.
K-SUBAGENT-2: SDK subagents may not inherit or expand capabilities beyond parent governance; child tool lists and cwd are restricted.
K-SUBAGENT-3: Subagent runs must produce parent-child runtime records and output artifact references when execution is enabled.

K-NET-1: Outbound network access is limited to explicit product scope; current shipped policy is loopback plus Anthropic API path, and non-Anthropic providers, remote MCP, and broader network access require bounded governed implementation scope.
K-KEY-1: API keys are non-project convenience state and must never be written to project files, runtime event payloads, logs, SDK transcripts if avoidable, or tool artifacts.
K-ATTACH-1: Attachments are server-validated and client metadata is non-authoritative; symlinks, directories, special files, unsupported extensions, and over-budget files are rejected.
K-RELEASE-1: Current release target is macOS 15+ Apple Silicon unsigned/unnotarized local-builder DMG unless amended.
K-VALIDATE-1: Required local checks must pass before release-significant changes are accepted (test, typecheck, harness:validate:premerge, instruction-root:integrity, desktop:dist).
K-RETIRED-1: Retired execution-scope items, including retired PKG-08 deliverables, remain out of scope unless reactivated by governed amendment.
K-DOMAIN-1: Domain engines own authoritative domain truth; Chirality governs interaction, proposals, records, and human gates and does not become the solver.
K-DOMAIN-2: Protected domain paths are write-quarantined; agents may write proposals and summaries, not protected domain-engine model truth.
K-DOMAIN-3: Domain operations require OperationProposal records and explicit human acceptance before application.
K-DOMAIN-4: Domain-engine outputs must not be represented as professional approval, code compliance, external validation, or solver truth owned by Chirality.
